## Today {.inverse}

<span class="kicker">THU AUG 13 · 1-4 PM</span>

We begin with a **policy question**, inspect the evidence, and learn what R and a coding agent each contribute.

## By 4 PM

- Open and run an R project
- Describe one row and one variable
- Inspect types, ranges, counts, and missingness
- Ask an agent to explain bounded code
- Verify one generated claim

## Four tools, four jobs

| Tool | Job |
|---|---|
| R | Compute |
| RStudio | Organize |
| Quarto | Combine code and narrative |
| Codex / Claude Code | Propose, explain, review |

**None of them decides whether the policy claim is valid.**

## Start with the file

```{.r}
library(tidyverse)

wdi <- read_csv(
  "data/derived/math-camp-wdi-2000-2022.csv"
)

glimpse(wdi)
count(wdi, year)
summarise(wdi, countries = n_distinct(iso3c))
```

## Lab 1 {.inverse}

<span class="kicker">EVIDENCE INVENTORY · 3-4 PM</span>
